add_library(ntdll INTERFACE)
fw_sdk_export_link_directories(ntdll "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
if(CMAKE_CL_64)
    target_link_libraries(ntdll INTERFACE ntdll_x64)
    install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ntdll_x64.lib" DESTINATION "${FW_SDK_LIB_DIR}")
else()
    target_link_libraries(ntdll INTERFACE ntdll_x86)
    install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ntdll_x86.lib" DESTINATION "${FW_SDK_LIB_DIR}")
endif()
